step1_analysis.description: A CAM cell that stores a data bit and compares it against a search bit, driving a match line. The paper describes a NOR-type CAM with a PMOS match-line driver to reduce search rush current, though the extracted netlist appears to contain some shorted nodes (e.g., D=G) likely due to extraction artifacts.

paper_reference.title: A Design for High-Speed Low-Power CMOS Fully Parallel Content-Addressable Memory Macros

search_energy.description: Energy consumed during a search operation

sky130_expected.calculation: E = VDD * I_avg * t_search. With VDD=1.8V and I_avg ~ 1uA over 1ns, E ~ 1.8 fJ per cell.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 131 fJ likely per word or macro. A single cell in 130nm at 1.8V will consume significantly less energy, dominated by local parasitic capacitance charging/discharging.

search_delay.description: Time from search line assertion to match line evaluation

sky130_expected.calculation: t = C * V / I. For a single cell, C is small (~5fF), I ~ 50uA, t ~ 0.2ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Macro-level delay in the paper includes long match lines and search lines. A single isolated cell will evaluate much faster.

mismatch_current.description: Current drawn from the match line during a mismatch condition

sky130_expected.calculation: I = 0.5 * un * Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs - Vth)^2. For W/L=10, I ~ 100uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: During a mismatch, the pull-down network is active, drawing significant current from the precharged match line.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to simulate Write, Match (Search 1), and Mismatch (Search 0) operations, measuring average currents to determine power and state.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CAM Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N2 N2 WL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N2 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 BL_BAR N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N2 BL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 BL_BAR N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 WL BL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 BL_BAR WL N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Match line bias/precharge
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

* Stimulus: Write (10-20ns), Search Match (30-40ns), Search Mismatch (40-50ns)
VWL WL 0 PWL(0 0 10n 0 10.1n 1.8 20n 1.8 20.1n 0 50n 0)
VBL BL 0 PWL(0 0 10n 0 10.1n 1.8 20n 1.8 20.1n 0 30n 0 30.1n 1.8 40n 1.8 40.1n 0 50n 0)
VBL_BAR BL_BAR 0 PWL(0 0 10n 0 10.1n 0 20n 0 20.1n 0 30n 0 30.1n 0 40n 0 40.1n 1.8 50n 1.8)

.control
tran 0.1n 50n

* Measure Match Line current during Match and Mismatch
meas tran I_match avg i(VLABEL_NET_1) from=32n to=38n
meas tran I_mismatch avg i(VLABEL_NET_1) from=42n to=48n

* Measure VDD current during search to estimate energy
meas tran I_vdd_search avg i(VVDD) from=32n to=38n

print I_match I_mismatch I_vdd_search
quit
.endc
